question: For which discovery did Henri Becquerel receive the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1903?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Spontaneous Radioactivity**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Henri Becquerel received the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1903 for his discovery of **Spontaneous Radioactivity**.
 
• He shared the prize with Marie Curie and Pierre Curie, who were also recognized for their work in the field of radioactivity.
